versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.7

- Updated documentation to clarify that Binance and CoinGecko use NS3's news data.
- Adjusted Breaking News feed limits from 20 to 30 in usage examples for improved real-time coverage.
- Minor description changes for greater clarity regarding features and data sources.
- Added a read me.txt file.

- Documentation link updated from /ns3-rss to /ns3-api for clarity and accuracy.
- Expanded purpose and philosophy section: clarified classification logic, added new "Similar Past Cases" insight, and made Level 1/2 criteria more explicit.
- Coverage section now includes explicit mention of security incidents (hacks, exploits, bridge failures).
- Improved explanation and explicit phrasing throughout for fact/analysis separation and classification process.
- Description order streamlined for consistency (API key mention moved forward).
- No functional or API changes; update is documentation and phrasing only.

- Documentation updated for clarity and conciseness in the SKILL.md.
- No functional or code changes; this version only includes descriptive improvements.

- Improved SKILL.md with expanded documentation, detailing AI news classification, coverage, language support, and feed usage scenarios.
- Clarified the importance ranking system (Levels 1–5) and how articles are filtered for quality and impact.
- Added guidance on token usage, feed selection for different user requests, and language codes for multi-language support.
- Included references to partnerships with Binance and CoinGecko for data verification.
- Outlined strict content quality controls to block promotional and low-value materials.
